title: Printable digital planners on Etsy at $9

source.text: Selling printable digital planners on Etsy at $9 each. Launch country US, budget $300, 8 hours a week, goal side income, no special edge. Just go: do not ask questions. Use the slug etsy-planners.

solution: Printable / digital planner files (PDF) sold as instant downloads on Etsy
assumptions: Customer assumed to be US Etsy shoppers buying generic planners (no niche stated)
Planners designed by the founder in a free tool such as Canva; no design track record
No questions asked: the user said 'just go'
Organic Etsy search is the main channel; Etsy Ads used only if they pay back
